name: Kohinata Otoha
source:
Otoha is the adoptive  mother of [url=/c10382]Yuuma[/url] and the biological mother of [url=/c10387]Sumomo[/url]. She runs the school cafeteria called Oasis. Otoha often does not act her age, she rather acts closer to her daughter's age. She is close friends with [url=/c10407]Suzuri Minagi[/url]. [spoiler]This is why Suzuri entrusts her to take care of Yuuma.[/spoiler]

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Happiness!#Characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
